evidence: Paper defines and operationalizes human-AI synergy as a formal concept analogous to strong synergy in human groups, using Hedges g vs max(human,AI) baseline
Paper formally defines human augmentation (human-AI > human alone) as a distinct weaker criterion from synergy, and reports pooled effect size g=0.64
Three-level meta-analytic model operationalizes and quantifies human-AI synergy concept across 370 effect sizes
